name: voicechat-monorepo
//: desktop, agent-tray и login-application НЕ в workspaces: у Electron-пакетов свой node_modules.

scripts.test: node --import tsx --test scripts/application-gate.test.mjs scripts/application-build.test.mjs scripts/application-deploy.test.mjs scripts/application-compatibility.test.mjs scripts/application-links.test.mjs scripts/component-installation.test.mjs scripts/component-readiness.test.mjs && node --test scripts/affected-check.test.mjs scripts/frontend-quality.test.mjs scripts/route-budgets.test.mjs scripts/long-run.test.mjs && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.frontend:typecheck: npm run -w @voicechat/ui-foundation typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/make-app typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/image-studio-app typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/ui-kit typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/sessions-core typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/sessions-app typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/profile-app typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/app-shell typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/chat-app typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/web-reader-app typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/playwright-reader-app typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/projects-app typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/operations-app typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/admin-app typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/ui typecheck && npm run -w @voicechat/web typecheck && npm --prefix apps/desktop run typecheck:web
scripts.frontend:test: npm run -w @voicechat/ui-foundation test && npm run -w @voicechat/make-app test && npm run -w @voicechat/image-studio-app test && npm run -w @voicechat/ui-kit test && npm run -w @voicechat/sessions-core test && npm run -w @voicechat/sessions-app test && npm run -w @voicechat/profile-app test && npm run -w @voicechat/app-shell test && npm run -w @voicechat/chat-app test && npm run -w @voicechat/web-reader-app test && npm run -w @voicechat/playwright-reader-app test && npm run -w @voicechat/projects-app test && npm run -w @voicechat/operations-app test && npm run -w @voicechat/admin-app test && npm run -w @voicechat/ui test && npm run -w @voicechat/web test
scripts.frontend:build-gates: npm run build:frontends && npm run -w @voicechat/web build && node scripts/frontend-quality.mjs --bundle && npm run build:storybook && npm ci --prefix apps/desktop && npm --prefix apps/desktop run build && npm run frontend:route-gates
scripts.frontend:route-gates: vitest run --config e2e/vitest.config.ts --no-file-parallelism e2e/routeBudgets.e2e.test.ts e2e/lazyBoundary.e2e.test.ts e2e/applicationFrontend.e2e.test.ts
scripts.verify:frontend: npm run frontend:static && npm run frontend:typecheck && npm run frontend:test && npm run frontend:build-gates
scripts.//storybook: Смоук-сборка витрины: единственное, что ловит сломанную сториз — tsc её JSX проверяет, а рендер нет.
scripts.//test:storybook: Фолбэк Component QA при пустой настройке test_command: смоук-сборка Storybook.
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build && npm run build:storybook && npm run typecheck:desktop && npm run test:desktop && npm --prefix apps/desktop run build && npm run typecheck:agent-tray && npm run test:agent-tray
scripts.//gate:fast: Проверки изменённых приложений рабочего дерева; общие контракты и неизвестные пути расширяют выбор. gate:all — полный гейт.
scripts.gate:fast:logged: node scripts/long-run.mjs start -- npm run gate:fast
scripts.//test:coverage: Покрытие трёх пакетов, где живёт 76% тестов. Пороги-трещотка заданы в их vitest.config.ts и падают по коду возврата.
scripts.test:coverage: npm run -w @voicechat/shared test -- --coverage && npm run -w @voicechat/server test -- --coverage && npm run -w @voicechat/ui test -- --coverage
scripts.gate:all: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build:frontends && npm run -w @voicechat/web-recorder build && npm run -w @voicechat/web build && npm run build:storybook && npm ci --prefix apps/desktop && npm --prefix apps/desktop run build && npm run frontend:route-gates
